title: Never having a birthday party
summary: No party or cake because all money went to living.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you, do you remember a, a birthday party for yourself? Or do you remember?
No, I've never had a birthday party.
Not, not when you were, when you were a child?
No, never had a birthday party, no.
Or any for your, your brother's assistant?
No, none of us, no. Cause I said, oh, my birthday was so and so, that's it.
But was there any recognition from your parents that it was your birthday?
Yeah, oh yeah, we, we never let, you know, everybody knew about, you know, when the birthday was coming, but we just didn't have no money for no party. All the money had to be. No cakes?
No, no, no. A special cake or a special dinner or something?
Everything was for, to live. Ain't no money for nothing else.
